results.what: Draft letter returning the print-ready manuscript of the Luftwellen memoir to the Göttingen Society for approval of printing. This dates the surrounding scratch work to c. late 1859 or early 1860.
results.modern_name: Biographical / dating evidence for 'Über die Fortpflanzung ebener Luftwellen von endlicher Schwingungsweite' (Abh. Ges. Wiss. Göttingen 8, 1860)

results.what: Faint, mostly illegible pencil computations. By context they relate to integrating w_{rs} - m(w_r+w_s)=0 via a Riemann (Green) function or via Fourier integrals with Cauchy data on σ=const.
results.modern_name: Riemann's method / Riemann function for linear hyperbolic equations in two variables; Fourier-integral solution of the Cauchy problem

deep.surprise_reason: The page is essentially a draft cover letter about printing the 1859/60 Luftwellen memoir, plus illegible pencil scratch work. The memoir and Riemann's method are well known as his. The only minor interest is archival: it confirms the drafting context and dating of the neighbouring calculations.

checkable.sympy: r,s=symbols('r s'); sigma,u=symbols('sigma u'); W=Function('W'); w=W(r+s,r-s); simplify(diff(w,r,s) - (Subs(Derivative(W(sigma,u),sigma,2),(sigma,u),(r+s,r-s)).doit() - Subs(Derivative(W(sigma,u),u,2),(sigma,u),(r+s,r-s)).doit()))
checkable.asserts: Context check (next page), not read from this page. With σ=r+s, u=r−s one has w_rs = w_σσ − w_uu, so the expression simplifies to 0.

checkable.sympy: r,s=symbols('r s'); W=Function('W'); w=W(r+s,r-s); sigma,u=symbols('sigma u'); simplify(diff(w,r)+diff(w,s) - 2*Subs(Derivative(W(sigma,u),sigma),(sigma,u),(r+s,r-s)).doit())
checkable.asserts: Context check: w_r + w_s = 2 w_σ, so the expression simplifies to 0. Hence w_rs − m(w_r+w_s)=0 becomes w_σσ − 2m w_σ − w_uu = 0.

checkable.sympy: s=symbols('sigma'); m=Function('m')(s); p1=Function('psi1')(s); p2=Function('psi2')(s); W=p1*diff(p2,s)-p2*diff(p1,s); simplify(diff(W,s) - (p1*diff(p2,s,2)-p2*diff(p1,s,2)))
checkable.asserts: Context check (Abel/Liouville): the derivative of the Wronskian equals ψ1ψ2'' − ψ2ψ1''. Combined with ψ'' = 2mψ' − μ²ψ this gives W' = 2mW, i.e. W = C·exp(∫2m dσ).

transcription_corrections: The letter is in ink and fairly legible. The closing reads roughly '[struck: Ehrerbietungsvoll …] … Hochachtungsvoll[st] / Ew. Hochwohlgeboren [ergebenster]'. The exact wording of the struck and closing formulas is uncertain.
The isolated word mid-page ('geschrieben' [?]) belongs to the faint pencil layer and has an underlined symbol (possibly '2' or 'z') beneath it, not part of the letter.

The pencil layer is not wholly blank. Fragments of fraction quotients of the type (A−B)/(C−D) and two-line integral expressions are visible in the lower middle, but too faint for a reliable transcription.
